151: class _HarnessClient:
152:     """Routes stage-function client.request(...) through the harness, with
153:     EXACTLY ONE telemetry job per dispatch (the instrumentation lives here and
154:     in the extraction window dispatcher; nothing else wraps a request).
155: 
156:     Stage functions call client.request([...], max_tokens=...) with the message
157:     list positional while the harness accepts keyword arguments only.
158:     Task reviewer packets carry their phase inside messages[1] ("interpret" or
159:     "match"); every other dispatch uses the stage label set before the call.
160:     Budget-related errors are re-raised for the stage function to record while
161:     harness.stop() is set so no further pack dispatches.
162:     """
163: 
164:     def __init__(self, harness, run, pack):
165:         self._harness = harness
166:         self._run = run
167:         self._pack = pack
168:         self.stage = "stage"
169: 
170:     def _label(self, messages):
171:         if (isinstance(messages, list) and len(messages) > 1 and
172:                 isinstance(messages[1], dict)):
173:             try:
174:                 packet = json.loads(messages[1]["content"])
175:             except (ValueError, TypeError, KeyError):
176:                 packet = None
177:             if isinstance(packet, dict):
178:                 phase = packet.get("phase")
179:                 if phase in ("interpret", "match"):
180:                     return "task_" + phase
181:         return self.stage
182: 
183:     def request(self, messages=None, **kwargs):
184:         if messages is not None:
185:             kwargs["messages"] = messages
186:         label = self._label(messages)
187:         job = self._run._begin(self._pack, label, label)
188:         try:
189:             result = self._harness.request(**kwargs)
190:         except Exception as failure:
191:             self._run._end(job, kwargs.get("job_id"), failure)
192:             raise
193:         self._run._end(job, kwargs.get("job_id"))
194:         return result

258:     def _dispatch_window(self, pack, data, plan, index):
259:         job = self._begin(pack, "extraction", "EX")
260:         window = plan.windows[index]
261:         fingerprint = _identifier({
262:             "messages": [r.original for r in data.message_records],
263:             "chats": [r.original for r in data.chat_records],
264:             "seed": data.seed})
265:         job_id = "extract:" + fingerprint[:16] + ":" + str(index)
266:         packet = window_packet(data, window)
267:         def validate(text):
268:             validate_extraction(text, data, window)
269:         observations, error = [], None
270:         try:
271:             text = self.harness.request(
272:                 messages=[{"role": "system", "content": EXTRACTION_PROMPT},
273:                           {"role": "user", "content": _encoded(packet).decode("utf-8")}],
274:                 max_tokens=2048, response_format={"type": "json_object"},
275:                 job_id=job_id, validate=validate,
276:                 cache_context={"stage": "extraction",
277:                                "prompt_version": EXTRACTION_VERSION,
278:                                "schema_version": 1,
279:                                "input_fingerprint": fingerprint,
280:                                "timezone_policy": "UTC", "as_of": data.as_of})
281:             observations = validate_extraction(text, data, window)
282:         except PilotRefusal:
283:             self._end(job, job_id)
284:             raise
285:         except (LLMError, ValueError, OSError, KeyError) as failure:
286:             error = failure
287:             code = ("invalid_response" if isinstance(failure, ValueError)
288:                     else "request_failed")
289:             self.extractions[pack]["failures"].append({"job": job_id, "code": code})
290:         self._end(job, job_id, error)
291:         return observations, job_id

293:     def _extraction_scope(self, pack, data, plan):
294:         """Mirror extract_windows per-window merging for the pilot scope."""
295:         result = {"state": "running", "required": [], "completed": [],
296:                   "failures": [], "observations": [], "pilot_scope": True,
297:                   "windows": []}
298:         self.extractions[pack] = result
299:         merged = {}
300:         for chat_id in ALLOCATION[pack]["windows"]:
301:             index = next(i for i, window in enumerate(plan.windows)
302:                          if window.chat_id == chat_id)
303:             try:
304:                 observations, job_id = self._dispatch_window(pack, data, plan, index)
305:             except PilotRefusal:
306:                 # Let the refusal propagate; run_pilot stops the harness with
307:                 # its real code (transmission_cap, unknown_usage, ...) so the
308:                 # evidence records the exact cause.
309:                 raise
310:             result["required"].append(job_id)
311:             result["completed"].append(job_id)
312:             result["windows"].append(job_id)
313:             for observation in observations:
314:                 observation["subjects"] = sorted(set(observation["subjects"]))
315:                 observation["evidence"] = sorted(observation["evidence"],
316:                                                  key=_encoded)
317:                 identifier = _identifier(observation)
318:                 if identifier not in merged:
319:                     merged[identifier] = dict(observation, id=identifier,
320:                                               windows=[])
321:                 if job_id not in merged[identifier]["windows"]:
322:                     merged[identifier]["windows"].append(job_id)
323:             result["observations"] = [merged[key] for key in sorted(merged)]
324:         result["state"] = ("incomplete" if result["failures"] else
325:                            "succeeded" if merged else "succeeded_empty")
326:         return result
327: 
328:     # ------------------------------------------------------------- stages
329:     def run_pack(self, pack, data, plan):
330:         spec = ALLOCATION[pack]
331:         client = _HarnessClient(self.harness, self, pack)
332:         extraction = self._extraction_scope(pack, data, plan)
333:         if self.harness.stopped is not None:
334:             return
335:         results = {}
336: 
337:         def record_stage(stage, value):
338:             results[stage] = value
339:             summary = {"state": value.get("state"),
340:                        "failures": len(value.get("failures", []))}
341:             pending = value.get("pending")
342:             if isinstance(pending, list):
343:                 summary["pending"] = len(pending)
344:             unresolved = value.get("unresolved")
345:             if isinstance(unresolved, list):
346:                 summary["unresolved"] = len(unresolved)
347:             self.stage_states[pack + "/" + stage] = summary
348: 
349:         if spec["organisation"]:
350:             client.stage = "organisations"
351:             record_stage("organisations",
352:                          resolve_organisations(data, extraction, client))
353:             if self.harness.stopped is not None:
354:                 return
355:         organisations = (results.get("organisations", {}) if spec["organisation"]
356:                          else orgs_pilot_scope())
357:         if spec["entities"]:
358:             client.stage = "entities"
359:             record_stage("entities",
360:                          resolve_entities(data, extraction, organisations, client))
361:             if self.harness.stopped is not None:
362:                 return
363:         if spec["goals"]:
364:             client.stage = "goals"
365:             record_stage("goals", resolve_goals(data, extraction, client))
366:             if self.harness.stopped is not None:
367:                 return
368: 
369:         sample_ids = set(spec["task_sample"])
370:         ledger_scope = {
371:             "state": extraction["state"], "required": extraction["required"],
372:             "completed": extraction["completed"], "failures": [],
373:             "observations": [o for o in extraction["observations"]
374:                              if o["kind"] in ("task_create", "task_update") and
375:                              all(span["message_id"] in sample_ids
376:                                  for span in o["evidence"])],
377:         }
378:         # Phase labels come from inside _HarnessClient.request, which already
379:         # instruments every dispatch exactly once.
380:         ledger = build_ledger(data, ledger_scope,
381:                               lambda packet, validate:
382:                               review_task_packet(client, packet, validate))

384:         if self.harness.stopped is not None:
385:             return

387:         if not spec["help"]:
388:             return

390:                   ("people", "organisations", "chats", "goals", "open_loops")}
391:         output.update(people=results.get("entities", {}).get("people", []),
392:                       organisations=organisations.get("items", []),
393:                       chats=results.get("entities", {}).get("chats", []),
394:                       goals=results.get("goals", {}).get("items", []))
395:         for task in ledger.get("tasks", []):
396:             item = {"title": task["action"] + " " + task["object"],
397:                     "type": task["type"], "owner": task["owner"],
398:                     "chat_id": task["chat_id"], "source_msg": task["source_msg"],
399:                     "status": task["status"], "due": task["due"]}

401:                 item["closed_by"] = task["closed_by"]
402:             output["open_loops"].append(item)

412:                                                 "code": "invalid_candidate"}]})

414:     # ---------------------------------------------------------------- run
415:     def execute(self):
416:         packs = {}
417:         for pack in PACK_ORDER:
418:             fixture = FIXTURE_ROOT / pack
419:             data = load_input(fixture)
420:             data.require_complete()
421:             packs[pack] = data
422:             self.fixture_hashes[pack] = {
423:                 name: hashlib.sha256((fixture / name).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
424:                 for name in ("chats.jsonl", "messages.jsonl", "seed.json")}
425:         for pack in PACK_ORDER:
426:             data = packs[pack]
427:             plan = build_windows(data)
428:             plan.require_complete()
429:             self.run_pack(pack, data, plan)
430:             if self.harness.stopped is not None:

433:     def evidence(self, mode, pricing=None):
434:         summary = self.harness.budget.summary()
435:         document = {
436:             "purpose": "Session-05 bounded pilot evidence (synthetic fixtures "
437:                        "only). The envelope is a planning constraint, not a "
438:                        "spend grant.",
439:             "mode": mode,
440:             "created": time.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ", time.gmtime()),
441:             "envelope": {
442:                 "max_transmissions": self.harness.limits.max_transmissions,
443:                 "max_recoveries": self.harness.limits.max_recoveries,
444:                 "token_reservation": self.harness.limits.token_reservation,
445:                 "spend_ceiling_usd": self.harness.limits.spend_ceiling_usd,
446:                 "network_seconds": self.harness.limits.network_seconds},
447:             "planned": count_plan()["planned_base_calls"],
448:             "telemetry": self.jobs,
449:             "stage_states": self.stage_states,
450:             "budget_summary": summary,
451:             "fixture_sha256": self.fixture_hashes,
452:             "synthetic_only": True,
453:             "stopped": self.harness.stopped,
454:         }
455:         if pricing is not None:
456:             document["verified_pricing"] = pricing
457:             document["projected_usd"] = self.harness.projected_usd()
458:         caps = (summary["attempts"] <= self.harness.limits.max_transmissions and
459:                 summary["recoveries"] <= self.harness.limits.max_recoveries and
460:                 not summary["over_ceiling"] and
461:                 summary["elapsed"] <= self.harness.limits.network_seconds)
462:         document["envelope_verified"] = bool(caps)
463:         document["run_state"] = ("stopped: " + self.harness.stopped
464:                                  if self.harness.stopped is not None
465:                                  else "completed")
466:         return document

468: 
469: def run_pilot(mode="test", transport=None, clock=time.monotonic, sleep=time.sleep,
470:               verified_pricing=None, provider_controls_confirmed=False,
471:               evidence_path=None):
472:     """Run the bounded pilot and return its evidence document.
473: 
474:     mode == "test" requires an injected offline transport (no network).
475:     mode == "real" additionally requires verified pricing, user-confirmed
476:     provider-side spend controls and runtime environment credentials before
477:     dispatch, and is gated upstream by explicit user authorization.
478:     """
479:     if mode == "test" and transport is None:
480:         return {"run_state": "refused", "stopped": "configuration",
481:                 "error_code": "configuration",
482:                 "message": "Offline runs require an injected transport.",
483:                 "synthetic_only": True}
484:     try:
485:         harness = PilotHarness(transport=transport, clock=clock, sleep=sleep,
486:                                verified_pricing=verified_pricing,
487:                                provider_controls_confirmed=provider_controls_confirmed)
488:     except PilotRefusal as refusal:
489:         return {"run_state": "refused", "stopped": refusal.code,
490:                 "error_code": refusal.code, "message": refusal.args[0],
491:                 "synthetic_only": True}
492:     run = PilotRun(harness)
493:     try:
494:         run.execute()
495:     except PilotRefusal as refusal:
496:         run.harness.stop(refusal.code)
497:     document = run.evidence(mode, pricing=verified_pricing)
498:     if evidence_path is not None:
499:         path = Path(evidence_path)
500:         path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
501:         with path.open("w", encoding="utf-8", newline="\n") as handle:
502:             handle.write(json.dumps(document, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2,
503:                                     sort_keys=True, allow_nan=False) + "\n")
504:     return document
505: 
506: 
507: def describe_plan():
508:     """The approved representative allocation, for review and evidence."""
509:     return {"pack_order": list(PACK_ORDER), "allocation": ALLOCATION,
510:             "totals": count_plan()}

39: def redact(value):
40:     for name, secret in os.environ.items():

42:                 len(secret) >= 8:

47: def cut(text):

53:             "%d chars cut in the transcript; full value in the raw export]" % \
54:             (len(text) - LIMIT)
55:     return text

58: def fence(text):
59:     return "`" * max(3, 1 + max((len(m.group()) for m in
60:                                  re.finditer(r"`+", text)), default=0))

# Write-up

*At most two pages.*

## What I focused on, and why

A cold-start pipeline that turns a raw chat-export dump (people, chats, messages,
seed circles) into five validated output categories — people, organisations,
chats, goals, open loops — with no pre-built semantics and no answer leakage.
The focus was readiness: fail-closed states instead of silent empty successes,
evidence-cited observations, deterministic replay, and a bounded, independently
supervised live-pilot path that can be approved or refused on evidence.

## My approach

Six standard-library modules (Python 3.9+): `data` (loading/indexing, exactly-once
4,000-char window spans with up to 2 context spans), `validation` (xpert-scoped
schema 1.0.0, unsupported inputs fail loudly), `llm` (structured failures, atomic
shared reservations, spawned-worker transport, run-local cache, deadlines),
`reasoning` (extraction packets with `covered` proof, entity/organisation/goal
resolution with evidence partitions), `tasks` (task-ledger interpretation and
same-chat/cross-chat matching), `solution` (deadline-gated atomic export of the
five arrays).

Model integration is OpenAI-compatible (`messages`,
`max_tokens`, `response_format: json_object`); `temperature` is omitted for
Gemini 3-family models. Extraction responses are re-validated against original
bodies; merges are deterministic; conflicts/pending stay explicit.

Pilot design (unchanged in scope): 25 planned base dispatches (EX-8, ORG-2,
ENT-3, GOALS-2, interpret 7 + match 2, HELP-1) over exactly four synthetic
multilingual fixture packs, through `PilotHarness` — a test-only envelope: 30
transmissions max, 5 recoveries, 250,000-token reservation, 600 s network
deadline, USD 2.00 internal paid-equivalent safeguard, fail-closed real-mode
gates (verified pricing, provider-side controls, environment credentials).
Current model: `gemini-3.5-flash-lite` (switched from `gemini-3.8-flash` on
2026-11-08), Free tier only: 15 RPM, 250K TPM, 500 RPD, no billing enabled;
the envelope fits inside all three limits serialized.

## What it costs

Verified pricing (official Google documentation, retrieved 2026-11-08):
`gemini-3.5-flash-lite` Standard paid rates are **$0.30 / Mtok input, $2.50 /
Mtok output** (thinking tokens included); context caching $0.03/Mtok; the Free
tier is **free of charge**.

Pilot: conservative projection at paid rates over the full envelope maximum
is ≈ **$0.16 worst case** — far inside the $2.00 internal safeguard. The pilot
runs on the Free tier, so the actual expected spend is **$0.00**; the projection
exists so a rate-limit or quota failure can still be budgeted, never billed.

Full dev set (4,502 messages, 138 chats, 280 windows; measured read-only in
Session 03, input hashes unchanged): extraction wire ≈ 1.43 M tokens plus 280 ×
2,048 completion reserve ≈ **$1.86 at Standard rates (≈ $0.41 per 1,000
messages)**, extraction-dominated; organisation/entity/goal/task/help families
add calls sized by real model output and are forecast in Gate 8 after the pilot.
On the Free tier: $0. Money goes ~100% to API tokens; nothing else is paid.

## Where it's wrong

- The token estimator counts wire bytes (+32), not tokens: it over-reserves for
  Latin content and can still understate mixed-script provider tokenization; a
  real overage stops the run rather than claiming compliance.
- Semantic recall/precision are unmeasured until the pilot's Gate 7 manual
  review against the independent expected matrix; the deterministic mock proves
  mechanics only, and scoped-pilot observation gaps are disclosed, not hidden.
- Known scaling fixes (bounded entity packets, context caps) are validated on
  15,000-message synthetic fixtures only; real chat idiosyncrasies could fail a
  packet cap, which records `incomplete` rather than truncating silently.
- Live latency/finish-rate behavior on the Free tier (15 RPM) may stop runs
  early via deadlines/backoff; that is an honest incomplete state.
- All 285 offline tests (Windows 3.12.9) and the Ubuntu 3.9.25 reruns pass, but
  no live Gemini request has been made yet: **pilot status NOT YET RUN**, and
  the GPU-free, no-spend discipline means H2/full-run approval remains separate.

"""Export the actual Session 07 conversation from the local OpenCode store.

The genuine raw payloads are read byte-faithfully from the `session_message`
rows of the local SQLite database (source of the session-06 archival, same
rules). Two artifacts are produced next to this script:

- `session-07-export.json`  raw export: complete session info plus every
  stored message payload in sequence order, unmodified (strings larger than
  the archiver limit stay untruncated here).
- `session-07-transcript.md` chronological transcript of the actual public
  dialogue: user messages and approvals, assistant visible text, tool calls
  with real inputs/outputs, agent switches, the read-only preflight, the
  approved model switch (gemini-3.8-flash -> gemini-3.5-flash-lite), every
  code change, test result, and the final PowerShell command. Hidden model
  reasoning parts, synthetic harness records and idle bookkeeping are
  excluded, as in the Session 04-06 archival rules; long strings are cut at
  20,000 characters with explicit `[truncated by archiver]` markers.

Nothing is reconstructed; credential-shaped strings are redacted; earlier
session transcripts (Sessions 00-06) are untouched. Re-run for a
byte-faithful post-response refresh; it atomically replaces only these two
Session 07 files.
"""
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import re
from datetime import datetime, timezone

SOURCE_DB = Path(r"C:/Users/Shalu Chauhan/.local/share/opencode/opencode.db")
SESSION_ID = "ses_e451f3c10ffevv4SLxROhjwYJp"
RAW = Path(__file__).with_name("session-07-export.json")
DOC = Path(__file__).with_name("session-07-transcript.md")
LIMIT = 20000


def stamp(ms):
    return datetime.fromtimestamp(ms / 1000, timezone.utc).strftime(
        "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%SZ")


def redact(value):
    for name, secret in os.environ.items():
        if re.search(r"(API_KEY|PASSWORD|SECRET|TOKEN)$", name, re.I) and \
                len(secret) >= 8:
            value = value.replace(secret, "[REDACTED]")
    return re.sub(r"\bsk-[A-Za-z0-9_-]{16,}\b", "[REDACTED]", value)


def cut(text):
    text = json.dumps(text, ensure_ascii=False) \
        if not isinstance(text, str) else text
    text = redact(text)
    if len(text) > LIMIT:
        return text[:LIMIT] + "\n[truncated by archiver: " + \
            "%d chars cut in the transcript; full value in the raw export]" % \
            (len(text) - LIMIT)
    return text


def fence(text):
    return "`" * max(3, 1 + max((len(m.group()) for m in
                                 re.finditer(r"`+", text)), default=0))


def tool_block(content):
    state = content.get("state", {})
    location = state.get("input", {})
    output = state.get("content")
    output_text = "\n".join(part.get("text", "") for part in output) \
        if isinstance(output, list) else ""
    return cut(json.dumps({"tool": content.get("name"),
                           "input": {key: location.get(key)
                                     for key in sorted(location)},
                           "output": output_text},
                          ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))


def parts(data, number, seq, ts, kind):
    excluded = {"reasoning": "hidden model reasoning", "reasoning-long": None}
    lines = []
    mark = "## %s | source seq %s | session line %s | %s\n\n" % (
        ts, seq, number, kind)
    blocks = data.get("content") if isinstance(data.get("content"), list) else []
    for item in blocks:
        ctype = item.get("type")
        if ctype == "text":
            body = cut(item.get("text", ""))
            f = fence(body)
            lines.append(mark + f + "\n" + body + "\n" + f + "\n")
        elif ctype == "tool":
            body = cut(tool_block(item))
            f = fence(body)
            state = item.get("state", {})
            note = "[persistent value: state.metadata holds a unified file " \
                "patch; see the raw export]" if isinstance(
                    state.get("metadata"), dict) and \
                    state["metadata"].get("files") else ""
            lines.append(mark + f + "\n" + body + "\n" + f + "\n" + note)
            continue
        elif ctype in excluded:
            continue  # Excluded per archival rules; raw export retains them.
        else:
            f = fence(cut(json.dumps(item, ensure_ascii=False, indent=1)))
            lines.append(mark + "### part type %s\n\n%s\n%s\n" % (ctype, f, f))
    return "".join(lines)


def export():
    import sqlite3
    raw_blocks, records, number = [], [], 0
    connection = sqlite3.connect(str(SOURCE_DB))
    try:
        info = connection.execute(
            "SELECT id, slug, directory, title, agent, model, time_created,"
            " time_updated FROM session_v2 WHERE id = ?", (SESSION_ID,)
        ).fetchone()
        rows = connection.execute(
            "SELECT seq, time_created, time_updated, type, data FROM"
            " session_message WHERE session_id = ? ORDER BY seq",
            (SESSION_ID,)).fetchall()
    finally:
        connection.close()
    info_record = {
        "session_id": info[0], "slug": info[1], "directory": info[2],
        "title": info[3], "agent": info[4], "model": info[5],
        "created": stamp(info[6]), "last_update": stamp(info[7])}
    for seq, created, updated, mtype, data in rows:
        payload = json.loads(data)
        json_line = redact(json.dumps({"seq": seq, "type": mtype,
                                       "data": payload}, ensure_ascii=False))
        raw_blocks.append(json_line)
        number += 1
        state = None
        if mtype == "assistant":
            for item in payload.get("content", []):
                if isinstance(item, dict) and item.get("type") in (
                        "text", "tool"):
                    state = item
        elif mtype == "user":
            state = {"type": "text"}
        elif mtype == "agent-switched":
            state = {"type": "switch"}
        excluded_note = {  # Inert bookkeeping kept in the raw export only.
            "synthetic": "_[excluded: synthetic harness record]_\n\n",
            "idle": "_[excluded: idle bookkeeping]_\n\n"}.get(mtype)
        if excluded_note:
            records.append(excluded_note)
            continue
        if state is None:
            records.append("## seq %s — excluded record type: %s\n\n" % (
                seq, mtype))
            continue
        ts = stamp(created if created else updated)
        if state["type"] == "switch":
            records.append("## %s | seq %s — agent switch %s -> %s\n\n" % (
                ts, seq, payload.get("previous", "?"), payload.get("agent")))
            continue
        if state["type"] == "text":
            body = cut(payload.get("text", ""))
            f = fence(body)
            records.append("## %s | seq %s — %s\n\n%s\n%s\n" % (
                ts, seq, "user", body, f))
            continue
        records.append(parts(payload, number, seq, ts, "assistant (tool)"))
    counts = {"user": 0, "assistant": 0, "synthetic": 0, "idle": 0,
              "agent-switched": 0, "other": 0}
    tools = 0
    for seq, created, updated, mtype, data in rows:
        counts[mtype if mtype in counts else "other"] += 1
        payload = json.loads(data)
        for item in payload.get("content", []):
            tools += int(isinstance(item, dict) and item.get("type") == "tool")
    raw = json.dumps({"session": info_record, "source_db": str(SOURCE_DB),
                      "exported_at": stamp(datetime.now(
                          timezone.utc).timestamp() * 1000),
                      "record_counts": counts, "tool_calls": tools,
                      "messages": [json.loads(line) for line in raw_blocks]},
                     ensure_ascii=False, indent=1).encode("utf-8")
    digest = hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
    header = (
        "# OpenCode Session 07 (bounded-pilot read-only preflight; approved\n"
        "final model switch to gemini-3.5-flash-lite; archival and manual\n"
        "run handoff) — chronological transcript\n\n"
        "- Source session ID: `%s`\n- Session title (at export time): %s\n"
        "- Agent: %s; model: `%s`\n- Directory: `%s`\n"
        "- Created: %s; last stored record at export: %s\n"
        "- Source: local SQLite OpenCode store (`session_message` rows of\n"
        "  `%s`); payloads retained byte-faithfully, not reconstructed.\n"
        "- Raw export: `session-07-export.json` (SHA-256 `%s`), archived\n"
        "  beside this transcript.\n"
        "- Excluded per archival rules: hidden model reasoning parts,\n"
        "  synthetic harness/system-reminder records, idle bookkeeping;\n"
        "  every user message and approval, assistant visible message,\n"
        "  agent switch and tool call with real inputs and outputs is\n"
        "  included below.\n"
        "- Long tool inputs/outputs are cut at %d characters with explicit\n"

        "  full.\n"
        "- Records in the raw export: %d (user %d, assistant %d, synthetic\n"
        "  %d, idle %d, agent-switched %d); tool calls: %d.\n"
        "- Credential-shaped strings are redacted; no API key is requested,\n"

        "\n---\n\n"
        % (info_record["session_id"], info_record["title"],
           info_record["agent"], info_record["model"], info_record["directory"],
           info_record["created"], info_record["last_update"],
           SOURCE_DB.as_posix(), digest,
           LIMIT, number, counts["user"], counts["assistant"],
           counts["synthetic"], counts["idle"], counts["agent-switched"],
           tools))
    content = header + "".join(records)
    store(RAW, raw)
    store(DOC, content.encode("utf-8"))
    return len(rows), tools, counts, digest


def store(path, data):
    temp = path.with_suffix(path.suffix + ".tmp")
    with temp.open("wb") as handle:
        handle.write(data)
    temp.replace(path)
    with path.open("rb") as handle:
        assert handle.read() == data


if __name__ == "__main__":
    rows, tools, counts, digest = export()
    print("exported records:", rows)
    print("tool calls:", tools)
    print("counts:", counts)
    print("raw sha256:", digest)
